description: A lifelong public servant, Jeff has lived in Chambers County since 2001 and brings over 45 years of experience in public safety as a firefighter, paramedic, and fire chief. He holds degrees in Public Safety Administration and Public & Private Management, and has served the Town of Five Points in elected office for more than two decades, including as Mayor.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Jeff Monroe
title: Meet Jeff | Jeff Monroe for Alabama State House District 37
